_comment: The table on Safety Carrier Board_A0. The board controls one impedance - 100 ohm differential for Ethernet, on the ETH-100 pair class - so one group and four rows, named by the Layer column. The 120 ohm CAN group was dropped: CAN needs no impedance control, its 120 ohm rule exists only to route the pair together at the general 0.2 mm trace width, and the table is meant to show what is actually controlled.
